# NOTICE: who owns what in library/

<!-- Generated by tools/build-notice.py from library/provenance.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The RabbiRabbit code (everything outside `library/` and `data/`) is under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`. **The MIT licence does not cover the Bible texts, commentaries and reference works in `library/`.** Each has its own terms, listed below. Where the table says "credit required" or "share-alike", those terms travel with the material.

## Rights tiers

- **A**: Clear historical public domain: old work, rights statement read or stated in the file, no specific uncertainty recorded
- **B**: Public domain (or own work) claimed, with a named uncertainty or only our own manifest as backing
- **C**: Licensed or mixed: needs credit, share-alike or other obligations
- **U**: Unrated: no rights claim recorded

Tiers describe how sure we are about the rights, not the quality of the work. The reasons are in `library/provenance.json`.

## Tier C

### Tyndale Open Study Notes  (`library/commentary/Tyndale`)
- Rights: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Why this tier: CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike; attribution required)
- Must do: Attribute to Tyndale House Publishers (2022), CC BY-SA 4.0, with a licence link, and indicate that changes were made.
- Must do: Our files are reshaped copies of the notes. If they count as adaptations, they must be distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (or a compatible licence). Whether they are adaptations, and what licence the repo applies to them, has not been reviewed.

### OpenBible cross-references  (`library/xref`)
- Rights: CC BY (OpenBible.info)
- Why this tier: CC BY (OpenBible.info); credit required
- Must do: CC BY credit to OpenBible.info (to confirm).

### topic-scores  (`library/topics/openbible_topic_scores.json`)
- Rights: CC BY (OpenBible.info)
- Why this tier: CC BY (OpenBible.info); credit required
- Must do: Credit OpenBible.info wherever the data is used (the site's geocoding page says it may be used for any purpose as long as OpenBible.info is credited).
- Must do: Attribution wording in the Worker not yet checked.

### xref-seed  (`library/seed/xref_seed_pool.json`)
- Rights: CC BY (derived from OpenBible.info cross references)
- Why this tier: CC BY (derived from OpenBible.info); credit required
- Must do: Credit OpenBible.info (the seed pool is derived from its cross references).

### characters  (`library/people/characters.json`)
- Rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the project; underlying sources carry their own licences
- Why this tier: CC BY-SA 4.0 (derived from Theographic); underlying sources carry their own licences
- Must do: CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and share-alike.
- Must do: Credit King James Version 1769, Easton's Bible Dictionary, Floyd Nolen Jones's The Chronology of the Old Testament, Linked Places format.

## Tier B

### Scofield Reference Notes (1917)  (`library/commentary/Scofield`)
- Rights: public domain
- Why this tier: Public domain claimed on our manifest only; 1917 text vs copyrighted 1967 New Scofield not yet checked

### Barnes' Notes (New Testament only)  (`library/commentary/Barnes-NT`)
- Rights: public domain
- Why this tier: Public domain by age expected, but the claim rests on our manifest only and no edition is recorded

### King James Version  (`library/bible/KJV`)
- Rights: public domain
- Why this tier: Public domain claimed; UK Crown patent caveat applies in the UK; claim rests on a repository README

### American Standard Version  (`library/bible/ASV`)
- Rights: public domain
- Why this tier: Public domain by age (1901); claim rests on a repository README, no dedication read

### overview-map  (`library/maps/book_overview_map.json`)
- Rights: own work: Tom's design (a hinge-chapter overview for each book), content drafted by Claude (AI) in a chat with Tom; editorial, not a historical source; no third-party list is known to be copied
- Why this tier: Own editorial work, AI-drafted at Tom's direction; no outside source known; it only picks which chapters an overview walks through

### Berean Standard Bible (BSB)  (`library/bible/BSB`)
- Rights: public domain from April 30, 2023
- Why this tier: Dedicated to the public domain 2023-04-30; owner page read. Open question whether the dedication covers our exact text
- Must do: Credit to Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.com and the Berean Bible Translation Committee is appreciated, not required.
- Must do: Do not call modified text 'Berean'.

### World English Bible Updated  (`library/bible/WEB`)
- Rights: public domain
- Why this tier: Public domain, text taken straight from the publisher's file (eBible.org, 30 Oct 2026); eBible.org confirmed in writing that the name may be kept with a notes label
- Must do: Trademark rule (eBible.org): "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org; if the actual text is changed in any way, the result should not be called the World English Bible. eBible.org agreed in writing (2026-11-07) that moving the footnotes to a separate layer is not a change, and that the name may be kept with a line such as "translator notes shown separately".
- Must do: Name shown to readers: "World English Bible Updated" (eBible.org's name for this edition); say that the footnotes are shown separately where notes are not displayed.
